description: Road Sweeping Schedule DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Schedule and Order of Road Sweeping for the administrative area of Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. These files contain the details of road sweeping in the DLR Co Co administrative area. The csv file contains the order and rota in which the roads will be swept and the pdf file displays the 2024 road sweeping calander. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown, environment, health-safety, maintenance. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
